AgreedActivity.description:
One activity the person said yes to in a conversation, held by the cloud for that local day so every
screen shows the same thing (tool `agree_activity`). `text` is a template from config/voice_lines.toml
(`voice_key`) around the activity's name and where it was agreed: never the person's words. It becomes
`done` by itself when an observation for that activity arrives the same day; a device reports `started`
(opened) or `put_aside` with POST /v1/me/agreed/answer. Gone after local midnight.

day.description: the local day it belongs to; it is not shown on any other day
day.title: Day

id.description: send it back in the answer; also the id in the stream's `agreed` events
id.title: Id

line.description: Kaiku's own short line from the conversation, when it gave one and it passed the wording rules
line.title: Line

name.description: how the activity is called on a screen ("Lantern", "a walk")
name.title: Name

on.description: the person's screens that can open it
on.title: On

opens_here.description: the asking device (`surface` in the query) has a screen for it; false: show it without an open button
opens_here.title: Opens Here

state_at.description: when it was opened, done or put aside
state_at.title: State At

text.description: the sentence for the card and the notification
text.title: Text

voice_key.description: the template used; speak `text` with POST /v1/voice/say
voice_key.title: Voice Key

when.description: now: they want to do it now, on another device. later: some time today
when.title: When

AgreedActivity.title: AgreedActivity

Invitation.description:
One thing Kaiku would like to bring up or offer now. Chosen by code; `text` is a template from
config/voice_lines.toml (`voice_key`) around the person's own stored words. On yes the device opens Talk
(kind talk_about: the session card already carries the thread) or the screen for `activity`.

id.description: send it back in the answer; an answered item is never offered again
id.title: Id

voice_key.description: the template used; speak `text` with POST /v1/voice/say
voice_key.title: Voice Key

Invitation.title: Invitation

description:
GET /v1/me/invitation — at most one invitation a day per home; null when there is nothing to offer, when
today's was answered, or on an extra-gentle day with nothing to talk about.

agreed.description: what the person said yes to today, on any device (D50), oldest first. While one is open or started the invitation waits (`invitation` is null)
agreed.title: Agreed

title: InvitationResponse
